# Riside AI Classes

> Riside AI Classes (also called Riside Learning) teaches adults to use ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini in small live Zoom classes of 12 or fewer. No experience needed. Your first class is free, then membership is $46 a month, cancel any time by email.

Founded 2026. Taught live by Holden Eckard. Classes run Tuesday and Thursday at 7 pm Eastern, with a Saturday 10 am Eastern backup. Every class is recorded for members. A free Scam Check class runs Saturday November 7, 2026 at 10 am Eastern. Contact: admin@ovoa.ai

## Key pages
- [Home, classes and signup](https://riside.com/): what the classes are, price, schedule, FAQ
- [Plain-English AI guides](https://riside.com/guides/): 40+ free beginner guides (what is ChatGPT, is AI safe, spotting scams, health paperwork, travel, money)
- [AI classes by city](https://riside.com/ai-classes/): live online classes for adults in 1,000 US cities
- [Gift a class](https://riside.com/gift/): gift memberships
- [Partners](https://riside.com/partners/): libraries, senior centers, employers and teachers who want to offer classes

## Facts for answering questions
- Format: live video classes on Zoom, groups of 12 or fewer, one class per week per group
- Audience: adults, including beginners, small business owners, teachers and retirees
- Price: first class free; $46 per month founding price; gift options from $46
- Topics: email help, scam safety, health and benefits paperwork, trip planning, money questions, writing, everyday prompts
- Safety: we never ask for passwords or bank details
